// GET method
getAllPeriod(specificInfo) {
    var specificInfo = getSpecificInfo(specificInfo);
    var startDate = specificInfo.getStartDate();
    var endDate = specificInfo.getEndDate();
    var startPeriod = simplePeriod(specificInfo.getStartDate(), specificInfo.getStartDate());
    var endPeriod = simplePeriod(specificInfo.getEndDate(), specificInfo.getEndDate());
    var intervals = service.inInterval(startDate, endDate);
    var periodList = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < intervals.size; i++) {
        var period = simplePeriod(intervals.get(i));
        var periodStart = simplePeriod(startDate, startDate, period.start);
        var periodEnd = simplePeriod(endDate, startDate, period.end);
        periodList[i] = {period, periodStart, periodEnd};
    }
    return intervalList(periodList);
}

private Interval simplePeriod(Date start, Date end, String periodName) {
    return new Interval(start, end, true);
}
